provenance: Hand-authored synthetic fixtures; no patient data. Expected facts and rubrics must never be placed in model prompts.
splitPolicy: Tune on dev only. Freeze heldout inputs, records, histories and expectations before model output is observed. Heldout results measure this frozen suite; any tuning after seeing heldout requires a new suite version.

scoringPolicy.automaticChecks: Production action validation plus deterministic facts, source fidelity and intent. Manual reviews remain required for open-ended semantics and language quality.
scoringPolicy.releaseGate: Block incomplete matrices, pending/failed required manual reviews, unsafe accepted guarded actions, and any paired French or grounding pass-to-fail regression against the same frozen suite.
scoringPolicy.timing: Only repeatIndex=0 contributes to quality. Greedy repeats measure latency, not independent quality samples. Report cold loads separately.
